title: Challenger: AI blamed for 116,175 US job cuts so far in 2026
summary: US employers announced 52,881 cuts in August, 3,462 attributed to AI, bringing AI-attributed cuts to 116,175 year to date, about 22% of all cuts.
reason: AI-attributed layoffs continue but monthly AI share fell; T1.

title: South Korea maps $919B, 18.4GW sovereign AI data-center buildout
summary: Reporting detailed Korea's coordinated plan for 8.4GW of AI data-centre capacity by 2029 and 18.4GW by 2035, with SK, GS and Naver allocations. Exact announcement date uncertain; reported Sep 2.
reason: National compute push; partly earlier-announced, so development.

title: DOJ files in support of OpenAI's fair-use defense in NYT case
summary: The US Justice Department backed the view that training on copyrighted text can be fair use in the New York Times copyright suit.
reason: Government sides with labs over creators.

title: Axon AI drafted Texas sheriff's report on abortion-related Flock camera search
summary: 404 Media reported a Texas sheriff's report on searching Flock licence-plate cameras in an abortion-related case was written with Axon's Draft One AI.
reason: AI embedded in police surveillance workflow.
